title.purpose: One per screen: the screen's name with its scope.

code.purpose: Key ids, secrets, request ids, IPs, receipts, access codes only.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Only for what floats: the one-time-secret dialog and the tablet drawer.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #1b6c80); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--accent, #1b6c80); color: var(--on-accent, #fff); font: 500 14px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 90ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #155a6b); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #155a6b); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1b6c80); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--control-soft, #cfd6da); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--sheet, #fff); color: var(--text, #131416); font: 500 14px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 140ms, border-color 140ms; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--raised, #f4f6f7); border-color: var(--control, #8a959b); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #1b6c80); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; font: 14px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text, #131416); } .ds-field span { font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--control, #8a959b); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--sheet, #fff); font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #1b6c80); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, #e2eff2); } .ds-field small { color: var(--muted, #565e63); font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: State with its text and a shape-coded dot.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--positive-soft, #ddf5e7); color: var(--positive-ink, #0c4027); font: 500 12px/1.2 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status--warn { background: var(--warning-soft, #fdf3e1); color: var(--warning-ink, #6b2f09); } .ds-status--warn::before { background: none; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; }

components.name: Exchange Light
components.description: Signature: the selected store's register/1C exchange status in the top bar.
components.html: Касса или 1С · подключена 5 минут назад
components.css: .ds-exchange { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--muted, #565e63); font: 13px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-exchange:hover { background: var(--active, #dde4e7); color: var(--text, #131416); } .ds-exchange strong { color: var(--text, #131416); font-weight: 500; } .ds-lamp { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--positive, #1e7b4f); }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar destination with an authored 16px icon; active is a grey pill with an accent icon.
components.html: API-ключи
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--muted, #565e63); font: 14px 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-nav:hover { color: var(--text, #131416); } .ds-nav--active { background: var(--active, #dde4e7); color: var(--text, #131416); font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav--active svg { color: var(--accent, #1b6c80); }

narrative.overview: A tinted L-frame (sidebar + top bar) is the register's body; a white sheet is its screen where each task happens. Colour goes on data and state; the petrol accent marks the one primary action, the current selection and focus. The exchange light in the top bar is the product's own element: whether the store's register or 1C is talking to the loyalty core.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted frame + white sheet, separated by one tone step
IBM Plex Sans throughout, Plex Mono for machine strings only
Shape-coded status marks, never colour alone
Short, functional motion with a fade-only reduced-motion path

rules.name: Colour budget under 3%
rules.body: Chrome stays grey; colour belongs to data and state.

rules.name: Flat at rest
rules.body: Only the dialog and the tablet drawer float.

rules.name: One title per screen
rules.body: 22px/600, the screen's name with its scope.

dos: Do keep one primary action per screen
Do use tabular figures wherever numbers align
Do keep labels in the accessibility tree when hiding them visually
donts: Don't use coloured left borders, gradients, glass or shadows at rest
